purpose: how winning long Bible-story videos open (first 30 s), to write the arc-02 compilation hook
query: Noah's Ark Bible story complete, long, 3 months, by views (9 results)

winners.title: NOAH AND THE GREAT FLOOD | The Full Bible Story of Noah's Ark | Genesis 6-9
winners.open_0_30s: Calm scene-setting narration: humanity multiplied, then 'a terrible problem'; no question, no stakes stated, no personal angle; subscribe plea at 1:02. Wins on title/thumbnail and length, not on the hook.

winners.title: The Man Who Built an Ark When It Had Never Rained Once | The Untold Story of Noah
winners.open_0_30s: Two stacked 'What if...' questions put the viewer in Noah's place (the whole world turns away; obedience means standing alone), then the promise in one sentence ('This is the account of Noah...'), then the stakes (preserved breath from the greatest catastrophe). Strongest explicit hook structure; it also adds interpretive layers later ('Perhaps Noah...', 'Picture for a moment...', 'This is what genuine faith resembles...').

structure_measured: 0-5 s: a question that puts the viewer inside the story (not a summary)
5-15 s: the cost of obedience / the stakes stated plainly
15-30 s: the promise of the video (what you will see), with the scope (Genesis 6-9 complete)
title carries character + 'Full/Complete Bible Story' + Genesis 6-9
closing of the top winner: a single moral line ('first response to deliverance was worship'), then a comment prompt
our_hook_rule: question that puts the viewer in Noah's place -> the stakes -> the promise (four stories, Genesis 5-9, KJV) -> one marked critical insight; ~10 s of speech
caution: the 367K winner is AI-labelled and pads with repeated subscribe prompts and invented dialogue; we do not copy that (KJV only, commentary marked apart)
